H4714H.name: Egypt
H4714H.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4714H.brief: Descendant of Ham, ancestor of African peoples
H4714H.short: Egypt (Mizraim) was a descendant of Ham and the ancestor of various African peoples, such as the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites, Pathrusites, Casluhites, and Caphtorites.

H4762I.name: Mareshah
H4762I.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H4762I.brief: Son of Mesha, re-founder of Hebron.
H4762I.short: Mareshah, a son of Mesha, was the father and re-founder of Hebron.

H4762H.name: Mareshah
H4762H.desc: Man or town at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4762H.brief: Son or town of Laadah in Judah.
H4762H.short: Mareshah, a son or town of Laadah,  a descendant of Shelah from the tribe of Judah.

H4764.name: Merab
H4764.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H4764.short: Merab, the eldest daughter of King Saul, was promised to David but given to Adriel.

H4778.name: Mered
H4778.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4778.brief: Son of Ezrah from the tribe of Judah.
H4778.short: Mered, a son of Ezrah, married Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh.

H4732H.name: Mikloth
H4732H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4732H.brief: A military commander during David's reign.
H4732H.short: Mikloth was the leader of the second division of David's army, serving during the second month of each year.

H4732G.name: Mikloth
H4732G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H4732G.short: Mikloth, a Benjamite, was the son of Eshek and lived in Jerusalem.

H4737.name: Mikneiah
H4737.desc: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4737.brief: A Levite musician during David's reign.
H4737.short: Mikneiah, a Levite, was one of the musicians appointed by David to play the harp during the procession of the ark to Jerusalem.

H4782H.name: Mordecai
H4782H.desc: Esther's relative living at the time of Exile and Return
H4782H.brief: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.
H4782H.short: Mordecai, Esther's cousin and guardian, played a crucial role in saving the Jews from Haman's plot during the reign of King Ahasuerus (Xerxes) of Persia.

H4782G.name: Mordecai
H4782G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4782G.brief: A leader who returned from Babylonian exile.
H4782G.short: Mordecai was one of the leaders who returned with Zerubbabel from Babylonian captivity to Jerusalem.

H4740G.name: Angle
H4740G.brief: A tower built by King Uzziah in Jerusalem.
H4740G.short: The Angle, a fortified tower constructed by Uzziah in Jerusalem.

H4714G.name: Egypt
H4714G.brief: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus
H4714G.short: Egypt, a powerful nation where the Israelites were enslaved until God delivered them in the Exodus.

H4714I.name: Egypt Sea
H4714I.brief: Likely the Gulf of Suez, part of the Red Sea
H4714I.short: The Egypt Sea, probably referring to the Gulf of Suez, an arm of the Red Sea.

H4723A.name: Kue
H4723A.short: Kue, a place from which Solomon obtained horses (<ref="1Ki.10.28; 2Ch.1.16">1Ki.10.28; 2Ch.1.16</ref>).

H4739.name: Makaz
H4739.brief: A place in one of Solomon's administrative districts
H4739.short: Makaz, a place in one of the twelve administrative districts established by Solomon (<ref="1Ki.4.9">1Ki.4.9</ref>).

H4722.name: Makheloth
H4722.brief: A place where the Israelites camped in the wilderness
H4722.short: Makheloth, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey (<ref="Numbers 33:25-26">Numbers 33:25-26</ref>).

H4719.name: Makkedah
H4719.brief: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua
H4719.short: Makkedah, a Canaanite city where Joshua defeated and executed five Amorite kings who had hidden in a cave (<ref="Joshua 10:16-28">Joshua 10:16-28</ref>).

H4785.name: Marah
H4785.brief: A place with bitter water on the Exodus route
H4785.short: Marah, a place where the Israelites found bitter water that Moses made drinkable by casting a tree into it (<ref="Exodus 15:23-25; Numbers 33:8-9">Exodus 15:23-25; Numbers 33:8-9</ref>).

H4762G.name: Mareshah
H4762G.brief: A town in Judah; fortified by Rehoboam
H4762G.short: Mareshah, a town in the Shephelah of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:44">Joshua 15:44</ref>), fortified by Rehoboam (<ref="2Ch.11.8">2Ch.11.8</ref>) and the site of Asa's victory over Zerah the Ethiopian (<ref="2Ch.14.9-10">2Ch.14.9-10</ref>).

H4796.name: Maroth
H4796.short: Maroth, a town in Judah mentioned in Micah's prophecy (<ref="Micah 1:12">Micah 1:12</ref>).

H4792.name: Merom
H4792.brief: A place where Joshua defeated Jabin's coalition
H4792.short: Merom, a place near the waters of Merom where Joshua defeated a coalition of Canaanite kings led by Jabin king of Hazor (<ref="Joshua 11:5, 7">Joshua 11:5, 7</ref>).

H4789.name: Meroz
H4789.brief: A place cursed for not helping against Sisera
H4789.short: Meroz, a place cursed by the angel of the Lord for not coming to help fight against Sisera (<ref="Judges 5:23">Judges 5:23</ref>).

H4706.name: Mizar Mount
H4706.brief: A mountain mentioned in a psalm of lament
H4706.short: Mount Mizar, a mountain mentioned in a psalm of lament, possibly representing a place of remembrance or longing for God's presence (<ref="Psalm 42:6">Psalm 42:6</ref>).

H4709G.name: Mizpah
H4709G.brief: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment
H4709G.short: Mizpah (Mizpeh, Ramah, Ramathaim-zophim, Arimathea), a city in Benjamin where the Israelites gathered for judgment and prayer (<ref="Judges 20:1, 3; 21:1, 5, 8; 1Sa.7.5-7, 11-12, 16; 10:17">Judges 20:1, 3; 21:1, 5, 8; 1Sa.7.5-7, 11-12, 16; 10:17</ref>), and the hometown of Samuel (<ref="1Sa.1.19; 2:11; 7:17; 8:4; 15:34; 16:13; 19:18-23; 20:1; 25:1; 28:3">1Sa.1.19; 2:11; 7:17; 8:4; 15:34; 16:13; 19:18-23; 20:1; 25:1; 28:3</ref>) and Joseph of Arimathea (<ref="Matthew 27:57; Mrk.15.43; Luke 23:50-51; Jhn.19.38">Matthew 27:57; Mrk.15.43; Luke 23:50-51; Jhn.19.38</ref>).

H4708G.name: Mizpeh
H4708G.brief: A town in the lowlands of Judah
H4708G.short: Mizpeh, a town in the lowlands (Shephelah) of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:38">Joshua 15:38</ref>).

H4709I.name: Mizpeh Valley
H4709I.short: The Valley of Mizpeh (Mizpah), a region near Mount Hermon where Joshua defeated the kings of the northern Canaanite coalition (<ref="Joshua 11:3, 8">Joshua 11:3, 8</ref>).

H4781.name: Merodach
H4781.short: Merodach, also known as Bel, was the chief god of the Babylonian pantheon.
